blocks.content: Grouping controls how Grafana bundles alert instances into notifications. Without grouping, each alert instance produces a separate notification. With grouping, Grafana combines instances that share the same label values into a single notification.
To configure grouping, complete the following steps:

In the notification policy you created, find the **Group by** setting.

The labels you list here determine how Grafana bundles alerts. Instances that share the same values for all listed labels go into one group.

For example:

| Group by | Effect |
|----------|--------|
| alertname | One notification per alert rule |
| alertname, instance | One notification per rule per host |
| team | One notification per team |

Choose how to group:

- **Default (inherit from parent)**: Uses the same grouping as the parent policy.
- **Custom labels**: Enter specific labels. For example, type `alertname` to get one notification per alert rule.
- **Group all**: Bundles every matching alert into a single notification.
In the next milestone, you will set timing intervals that control when Grafana sends and resends notifications.
